technicalNotes:
Might be stored in Combination with B10B3/037043 in Airbag Kontrol Modülü (J234), if so Gerçekleştirin: Function Test first.
If the ABS / ESP Fren Elektroniği Function Test procedure will not complete and fault codes are stored in other Powertrain Databus Kontrol Modülüs diagnose those issues before replacing ESP components.
Refer to the Volkswagen Tech Tip [45-09-05] ONLY if the "Electronic Stabilization Program (ESP) function test does not end after several attempts!  https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2020/MC-10180603-0001.pdf  NHTSA
